name: Self-Attention 101
description: Six tokens, a 6x6 map of who read whom

params.value: the cat sat on the mat

data.noteContent:
One attention head with nothing hidden: text, tokens, an 8-wide embedding, sinusoidal positions, then the three projections and a softmax over the scores. The sentence tokenises into 6 tokens, so the heatmap on Edu-SelfAttention is 6 by 6 -- row i is how much position i read each position, and every row sums to 1. Nothing is trained; the projections come from seed 42. Set causal to true to block the upper triangle, or drop temperature below 1 to sharpen each row. The first run needs the network: it downloads the cl100k_base table, and later runs are offline.

一個 attention head，整條攤開來看：文字、token、8 維 embedding、sinusoidal 位置編碼，接著三組投影和對分數取 softmax。這句話會切成 6 個 token，所以 Edu-SelfAttention 上的熱圖是 6 列 6 欄 — 第 i 列是位置 i 對每個位置放了多少注意力，每一列加起來是 1。沒有任何東西訓練過，投影由 seed 42 決定。把 causal 改成 true 可以擋掉上三角，把 temperature 調到 1 以下則讓每一列更集中。第一次執行需要連網：它會下載 cl100k_base 表，之後就不需要網路。

cl100k_base keeps the leading space, so 'the' and ' the' are two different tokens and land on two different rows. mode is ordinal, which hands out rows in first-appearance order -- 6 of the 32 here. The table is random and never trained.

cl100k_base 會保留前面的空白，所以 'the' 和 ' the' 是兩個不同的 token，落在表裡不同的兩列。mode 設成 ordinal，依照第一次出現的順序發號碼 — 這裡用掉 32 列中的 6 列。這張表是隨機的，從來沒有訓練過。

Read the map by rows: row i is where position i looked. causal blocks everything to the right of the diagonal; temperature divides the scores before the softmax, so under 1 concentrates a row and over 1 spreads it out.

這張圖要一列一列讀：第 i 列是位置 i 看向哪裡。causal 會擋掉對角線右邊的全部格子；temperature 在 softmax 之前先除分數，小於 1 會讓一列更集中，大於 1 則更平均。
